+"""Database connection and session configuration."""
+
+import os
+from typing import Generator
+from sqlalchemy import create_engine
+from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, sessionmaker, Session
+
+DEFAULT_DB_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "pilot_app.db")
+DEFAULT_DB_URL = f"sqlite:///{DEFAULT_DB_PATH}"
+
+Base = declarative_base()
+
+
+def get_engine(db_url: str | None = None):
+    url = db_url or os.getenv("DATABASE_URL", DEFAULT_DB_URL)
+    if url.startswith("sqlite:///:memory:"):
+        raise ValueError("sqlite:///:memory: is not permitted; use a file-backed database.")
+    return create_engine(url, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False} if url.startswith("sqlite") else {})
+
+
+def init_db(engine) -> None:
+    """Explicitly initialize database tables without side-effects on module import."""
+    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
+
+
+def get_session_factory(engine):
+    return sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)

+"""SQLAlchemy models for core T1 domain entities: users, uploads, and exams."""

+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Column, DateTime, ForeignKey, String, Text

+
+
+def generate_uuid() -> str:
+    return str(uuid.uuid4())
+
+
+def utc_now() -> datetime:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)

+
+class User(Base):

+"""Tests for SQLite persistence schema creation and initialization behavior."""
+
+import os
+import pytest
+from sqlalchemy import inspect
+from pilot.app.backend.db import Base, get_engine, init_db, get_session_factory
+from pilot.app.backend.models import User, Document, GeneratedExam
+
+
+def test_init_db_creates_tables_in_temporary_file_sqlite(tmp_path):
+    db_file = tmp_path / "test_pilot.db"
+    db_url = f"sqlite:///{db_file}"
+    
+    engine = get_engine(db_url)
+    inspector_before = inspect(engine)
+    assert not inspector_before.has_table("users")
+    assert not inspector_before.has_table("documents")
+    assert not inspector_before.has_table("generated_exams")
+
+    init_db(engine)
+
+    inspector_after = inspect(engine)
+    tables = inspector_after.get_table_names()
+    assert "users" in tables
+    assert "documents" in tables
+    assert "generated_exams" in tables
+
+    session_factory = get_session_factory(engine)
+    with session_factory() as session:
+        user = User(email="student@example.edu")
+        session.add(user)
+        session.commit()
+
+        doc = Document(user_id=user.id, title="midterm.pdf", doc_type="EXAM_SAMPLE", storage_path="/data/midterm.pdf")
+        exam = GeneratedExam(user_id=user.id, title="Practice Midterm")
+        session.add(doc)
+        session.add(exam)
+        session.commit()
+
+        assert session.query(User).count() == 1
+        assert session.query(Document).count() == 1
+        assert session.query(GeneratedExam).count() == 1
+
+
+def test_rejects_memory_sqlite_database():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="sqlite:///:memory: is not permitted"):
+        get_engine("sqlite:///:memory:")
